Name: Carry Chest
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Carry Chest [/b]lets you pick up chests even if they're not empty.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
Just pick up a chest like normal, even if it's not empty! (To pick up a chest, interact with it when your toolbar has an empty slot selected.)

[b]Caution:[/b] placing a non-empty chest without the mod installed will lose its contents.


[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
